bg-canvas.$description: Page background. Brand black in dark; white in light.

bg-surface.$description: Sections, sidebars, alternating bands on the canvas.

bg-raised.$description: Cards and panels on canvas or surface (pair with border-default and shadow-1).

bg-sunken.$description: Inputs, code wells, track of switches. Always with border-strong.

bg-inverse.$description: Inverted blocks: the primary button, toasts, high-emphasis chips.

bg-hover.$description: Hover wash on neutral rows, ghost buttons and list items.

bg-selected.$description: Selected rows, active nav item, chosen option.

bg-glass.$description: Glass panels over imagery or gradient; always with blur-glass and border-subtle.

text-primary.$description: Body and headings on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-overlay (≥15:1 both themes).

text-secondary.$description: Supporting copy and descriptions on every bg-* surface (≥6.4:1 dark, ≥9.7:1 light).

text-muted.$description: Captions, meta, placeholders on every bg-* surface (≥4.9:1 dark, ≥4.9:1 light).

text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums).

text-link.$description: Inline links on canvas and surfaces (7.8:1 dark on black, 5.2:1 light on mist).

border-subtle.$description: Hairline dividers inside cards and tables; decorative only.

border-default.$description: Card, panel and table outlines; decorative only.

border-strong.$description: Borders of interactive controls: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons (≥3:1 on every surface).

accent.$description: Axon Signal blue: signal buttons, selected controls, focused data. Text on it is on-accent.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed (5.6:1, 7.8:1, 5.0:1).

focus-ring.$description: 2px focus outline with 2px offset, on every surface (≥3:1).

action-primary.$description: Primary button fill: monochrome by design (white on dark, black on light).

on-action-primary.$description: Label on action-primary fills (≥10:1 in every state).

tone-pulse.$description: Pulse accent text and icons: live, real-time, energy highlights. On every bg-* surface (≥5.6:1 dark, ≥5.4:1 light).

tone-synapse.$description: Synapse accent text and icons: AI-generated content, models, intelligence (7.1:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tone-signal.$description: Signal accent text and icons: data, metrics, interactive hints.

tone-pulse-subtle.$description: Pulse tinted background for badges and callouts.

tone-synapse-subtle.$description: Synapse tinted background for AI badges and callouts.

tone-signal-subtle.$description: Signal tinted background for info badges and callouts.

status-success.$description: Success text/icon on canvas and surfaces (11:1 dark, 5.0:1 light). Always pair with an icon or word.

status-warning.$description: Warning text/icon on canvas and surfaces (11.6:1 dark, 5.4:1 light). Always pair with an icon or word.

status-danger.$description: Error text/icon on canvas and surfaces (7.4:1 dark, 5.1:1 light). Orange-red, kept apart from Pulse magenta.

shadow-signal.$description: Signal glow: AI-active elements and the focused hero input. Once per view.
